title: SBI Holdings, SBI VC Trade, Circle, Ripple and RLUSD operational terms

source_capture_policy.reason: Primary issuer/company pages were rendered for research but byte-exact responses and independent timestamp anchors were not captured. No values are admitted to predictive features.

claims: SBI VC Trade, a consolidated subsidiary of SBI Holdings, began handling RLUSD in its VCTRADE service on June 24, 2026.
SBI VC Trade classified RLUSD as a Type 4 electronic payment instrument under its stated Japanese-law interpretation.
BITPOINT service is excluded from this launch notice.
Withdrawal/transfer limit is JPY 1,000,000 per transaction; deposits above JPY 1,000,000 may take additional time to reflect; a daily deposit ceiling also applies but its amount is not disclosed.
SBI VC Trade may restrict trading/deposits if deposited RLUSD exceeds its redemption capacity.
The notice says supported blockchains would be expanded sequentially; it does not itself establish current XRPL deposit/withdrawal support.
RLUSD ranked first by rate of increase in assets held at SBI VC Trade during September 2026.
The page does not disclose the absolute RLUSD balance, net deposits, net purchases or XRP conversions.
SBI Holdings' corporate history records an investment in Circle Internet Group in June 2025.
It records SBI VC Trade's USDC public offering in March 2025.
The parent legal entity is SBI Holdings, Inc., established July 8, 1999, whose principal business is control and management of the SBI Group through share ownership.
RLUSD issuer is Standard Custody & Trust Company, described as a wholly owned Ripple subsidiary.
BNY is identified as the primary reserve custodian.
The page states third-party monthly reserve verification and displays historical supply/reserve figures dated August 27, 2026; those figures are not a November 5 balance.

edges.evidence: SBI VC Trade's official June 24 notice identifies itself as a consolidated subsidiary.

not_established: Absolute RLUSD balance or net flow at SBI VC Trade.
SBI VC Trade XRPL deposit/withdrawal support as of November 5, 2026.

operational_terms.legal_classification: Type 4 electronic payment instrument under SBI VC Trade's stated Japanese-law interpretation
operational_terms.fees: SBI VC Trade notice states no deposit/withdrawal fee
operational_terms.chain_support: The launch notice says additional supported blockchains would be added sequentially; current XRPL support is unverified from the reviewed primary notices.

holdings_signal.metric: rate of increase in assets held at SBI VC Trade
holdings_signal.interpretation: Relative growth ranking only. It cannot be converted into an absolute balance, net capital inflow or XRP demand.

capital_accounting.sbi_holdings_circle_investment: Actual equity investment into Circle, amount not stated on the cited corporate-history page.
capital_accounting.sbivc_usdc_distribution: Distribution/listing activity; not an SBI investment into USDC.
capital_accounting.sbivc_rlusd_distribution: Distribution/listing activity; not an XRP purchase.
capital_accounting.rlUSD_customer_holdings: Custody/holding balance stock, not necessarily new net issuance or spot XRP demand.

admission.reason: Issuer/company relationship and operational terms are not synchronized market-flow data; absolute balances and XRP conversion flows are undisclosed.

next_evidence_requirements: Obtain exact SBI VC Trade monthly RLUSD custody balance and net deposit/redemption data.
Verify current supported chains from a dated SBI VC Trade operational notice or API.
Obtain transaction-level RLUSD/XRP conversion and XRPL settlement volumes before attributing demand to XRP.
